limitations: Same or visually continuous battle; no genuinely independent battle established.

All scores are development replays, not statistical accuracy estimates. No temporal event deduplication beyond source-frame grouping demonstrated; no live-stream load, latency distribution, or production state integration validation.
No full battle grammar, icon/team identification, damage inference, or broad menu/ability/HP geometry coverage. Full dictionaries not replayed.
A research runner is not a production OCR engine; confirmed-event output intentionally disabled. Manual reference is local and only aggregate results are public.
